thread:
nina: Hi all — Nina here (Product Designer, Growth). First day! Quick blockers: 1) can't open Growth Figma prototype (403), 2) where's the single-page roadmap summary I can skim, 3) who handles recruiting for 5 quick user interviews? TL;DR: perms + docs + research contact pls.

omar: welcome Nina! :tada: For Figma, DM the file link and your redwood email and i'll invite you. If SSO is flaky try an incognito window.

tess: added you to Design - Growth a moment ago. Try the Figma link again and lmk.
nina: link: https://www.figma.com/file/GROWTH-UI/rdw-growth-proto — still 403 for me.
tess: sometimes the board's permissions are set to team-only. Omar, can you flip duplication for Growth?
omar: done — gave Growth Editors access. If still 403, run `open "https://sso.redwood.com"` and refresh.
nina: that fixed it, I can open now 44c thanks!

omar: roadmap shortform is in Notion: https://redwood.notion.site/Product-OnePager (one-pager with top bets + metrics). For the full roadmap use Product > Roadmap.
nina: perfect. And research recruiting — who do I ask about recruiting 5 participants (paid) for a rapid usability run?
julian: Julian from Research Ops here. Use the Research Request form: https://redwood.notion.site/Research-Requests. Select "paid participants", fill the screener, and tag me @julian. We usually need 72hrs lead time but can expedite for 24hrs with a small fee.
nina: thanks — i'll submit the form now. Any templates for short interview scripts / consent language?
julian: yes — Research Playbook has a "5-question usability" template and consent wording. Link in the request form. Also if you want, i'll drop a starter recruitment screener after you post the task.

tess: quick pro-tip: if you're previewing interactive flows, enable the Figma prototype's "Mirror" option so PMs can try on mobile. Also post the link in #prod-design-review for feedback.
onboarding-bot: Nina added to: Product Team, Design - Growth, Research Guild. Onboarding checklist updated (Tasks: confirm Figma access, read one-pager, submit research request).
nina: great — appreciate the speedy help. i'll post the prototype in #prod-design-review and file the research request. Thanks everyone!
